tasks.description: Initialize Electron main process and app lifecycle
steps: App launches a single main process without errors
Main process logs basic startup status and exits cleanly
Renderer window creation is wired from main process
Polling scheduler can be started/stopped from main process

tasks.description: Create basic shell UI layout in renderer (dashboard + sidebar + detail pane)
steps: Window loads a React UI without console errors
Shell layout displays sidebar, main list, and detail pane
Empty states are shown when no repos or PRs exist

tasks.description: Add repo path input flow (manual path entry)
steps: User can input a repo path string (e.g., ~/git/my-repo)
Path is normalized to absolute path
Invalid paths show a user-visible error
Valid path is stored and shown in UI list

tasks.description: Local storage (hybrid): SQLite for metadata + file storage for diffs
steps: SQLite schema includes repos, PRs, runs, suggestions metadata
Diff content is stored as a file with a stable identifier
DB stores pointer to diff file location
CRUD operations for repos and PRs succeed

tasks.description: Integrate gh CLI auth and validation
steps: `gh auth status` is executed from main process
Unauthenticated state prompts user to run `gh auth login`
Authenticated user info is available to the app

tasks.description: PR discovery for local repo using gh CLI
steps: App can list PRs authored by the current user for a repo
PR list includes number, title, branch, and status
Failure to fetch PRs is handled with error messaging

tasks.description: Polling loop for PR checks (120s interval)
steps: Polling starts automatically after repo added
Poll runs every 120s with no overlap
PR check status updates are persisted
Manual refresh can be triggered from UI

tasks.description: Fetch failed run logs for failing PR checks
steps: Failing run is identified via gh PR checks
Log fetch uses `gh run view --log-failed`
Log output stored alongside run metadata
Errors in log fetch are surfaced to UI

tasks.description: Failure classification (hybrid heuristic + model fallback)
steps: Heuristic classifier tags infra vs code failures using keywords
If ambiguous, request Copilot classification
Infra failures are marked as non-actionable
Code failures are marked as actionable

tasks.description: Copilot SDK integration with toolset for log reading and file reading
steps: SDK session can be created with tools
Tool for CI log retrieval is available to the model
Tool for reading local file content is available
Model receives system prompt aligned with fix-only scope

tasks.description: Suggestion generation for lint/unit/format errors
steps: Model produces a textual diff for code failures
Diff is stored as virtual diff (no local file mutation)
Suggestion metadata includes PR/run references
Non-code failures skip suggestion generation

tasks.description: PR list UI with status indicators
steps: List shows PRs for selected repo
Each PR shows status badge (passing/failing/analyzing)
Failed PR indicates actionable vs non-actionable

tasks.description: Diff viewer for suggested fix
steps: Diff panel renders the stored virtual diff
Diff panel shows PR and run metadata context
Empty state shown if no suggestion exists

tasks.description: Apply action UI (suggest-only, no auto-commit)
steps: UI can request apply of suggestion
Apply action writes patch to working tree only
No auto-commit or push occurs
Success/failure feedback is shown

tasks.description: Settings UI for model selection
steps: Settings screen exposes model selection input
Selected model value is persisted
Model value is used when starting SDK sessions

tasks.description: Model discovery strategy (if SDK lacks list)
steps: If SDK provides model list, populate settings from it
If not, accept free-form model name with validation error feedback
Document expected model identifiers for the user

tasks.description: Basic error handling and telemetry-safe logging
steps: Errors are logged locally without exfiltrating code
UI shows user-friendly error toasts/messages
Log files avoid sensitive repo content

tasks.description: End-to-end smoke flow
steps: Add repo path → PRs appear
Failing PR detected → logs fetched
Actionable failure → suggestion generated
Diff displayed in UI

tasks.description: Apply virtual diff to working tree
steps: Diff parser supports unified diff format
Patch apply succeeds for supported files
Conflicts are detected and reported
Apply action never commits or pushes

tasks.description: Basic test coverage for core services
steps: Repo path normalization has unit tests
PR polling scheduler has unit tests
Failure classifier has unit tests
Diff storage loader has unit tests

tasks.description: MVP usage documentation
steps: README includes setup and required tools
Document how to authenticate with gh CLI
Document model selection behavior
